notes: 整理说明：(1) 本卷没有独立的答案文件（目录里不存在「省赛一(答案).pdf」），但 24年国才杯笔译省赛一.pdf 本身就是含作答/答案的版本：第一部分术语填空的空格已被答案填上，英译汉每段英文后紧跟中译、汉译英每段中文后紧跟英译。因此 reference 取自这份 PDF 的正文本身，不是自己翻译的（与 2024-sample.json 用卷内「解析」充当 reference 是同一做法）；若口径要求「必须有独立答案文件」才收 reference，把本文件所有 reference 清空即可，其余字段不用动。(2) 提示词里给的抽取文本（24年国才杯笔译省赛一.txt）是按单字换行、阅读顺序错乱的，本次改为直接从 PDF 重新抽取（PyMuPDF，按行重排后按阅读顺序拼接）。(3) 原文照录，并修正抽取造成的明显错字：30 vears→30 years、acccleration→acceleration、fossil fucls→fossil fuels、Policy firameworks→Policy frameworks、ccological→ecological、to0align→to align；中文原文里 多村旅游→乡村旅游、乡士民俗→乡土民俗、非遇传承人→非遗传承人。(4) 照录未改的：英译汉 5 段里有 4 段结尾原文就没有句号（停在「it will sustain」「sustain its implementation」「supports the energy transition」「university courses」）；中文原文「有效地增强了旅游吸引力」后缺句号直接接「同时，」；破折号排印不一致（如 needs-—whether）；阿拉伯数字与汉字交界处的空格（如「在未来30 年内」）。(5) 汉译英那篇的英文参考译文里有 7 处句末标点后缺空格（return.These、area.With、alive:local、stoves.Only、tourism.For、priority.Overdevelopment、benefits.Some），已各补回一个空格（与 2025-may.json 处理答案排版的做法一致）；英译汉原文与中译英中文原文都没有这类问题。(6) 卷头（比赛名称、场次与日期）、题号与分值说明行，以及页眉页脚水印（「更多资料请关注bilibili:LAN 浨爱冒险/一只五哈怪」「请勿搬运/二次贩卖」「大学竞赛/考证资料请关注【公众号】一只五哈怪」）均已剔除。(7) 第一部分的 4 个术语填空（含阐释）属非语篇题型，未收录。(8) 段落：英译汉原文 5 段对参考译文 5 段，汉译英原文 3 段对参考译文 3 段。

articles.text:
A profound and systemic transformation of the global energy system must be achieved within 30 years. This condensed timeframe necessitates a strategic shift that expands beyond the focus on decarbonization of energy supply and energy consumption, toward designing an energy system that not only reduces carbon emissions but also supports a resilient and inclusive global economy. As a result, planning needs to extend beyond borders and the narrow confines of fuels to focus on the requirements of the new energy system and the economies it will sustain

Focusing on the enablers of a renewables-dominated system can help address the structural barriers that hinder progress in the energy transition. Pursuing fuel and sectoral mitigation measures is necessary, but is insufficient to transition to an energy system fit for the dominance of renewables. From energy production and transportation to processing coal, oil and gas, the global infrastructure dedicated to energy will need to change. This will have impacts on power generation, industrial production and manufacturing, as well as on rail pipelines, and other means of supplying fossil fuels. Enhancing the focus on systems design will help accelerate the development of a new energy infrastructure and sustain its implementation

Governments can proactively shape a renewables-based energy system, overcome the flaws and inefficiencies of current structures, and more effectively influence outcomes. The simultaneous proactive shaping of physical, policy, and institutional structures will be essential to realizing development and climate objectives and achieving a more resilient and equitable world. These underpinnings should form the pillars of a structure that supports the energy transition

Policy and regulatory enablers must systematically prioritize the acceleration of the energy transition and a reduction in the role of fossil fuels. Today, the underlying policy and regulatory systems remain shaped around fossil fuels. While it is inevitable that fossil fuels will remain in the energy mix for some time, their share must dramatically decrease as we approach mid-century. Policy frameworks and markets should therefore focus on accelerating the transition and provide the essential underpinnings for a resilient and inclusive system.

A well-skilled workforce is a lynchpin of a successful energy transition. A broad range of occupational profiles will be needed. Filling these jobs will require concerted action in education and skills building, and governments have a critical role in coordinating efforts to align the offerings of the education sector with projected industry needs-—whether in the form of vocational training or university courses

在未来30 年内，全球能源系统必须实现深刻且系统性的转型。这一紧迫的时间框架要求战略视角的拓展，不再局限于能源供应和消费的脱碳化，而是着眼于构建一个既能减少碳排放、又能支持全球经济韧性与包容性的能源系统。因此，规划应超越国界与燃料的狭隘限制，聚焦于新型能源系统及其所支撑经济的实际需求。

聚焦于支持以可再生能源为主导的系统转型，有助于解决阻碍能源转型的结构性障碍。尽管燃料和行业的减排措施是必不可少的，但仅靠这些还不足以推动适应可再生能源主导的能源系统的转型。从能源生产、运输到煤炭、石油和天然气的加工，全球现有的能源基础设施将需要进行深层次的变革。这将影响发电、工业生产与制造业，以及铁路、管道等化石燃料的供应方式。加强对系统设计的重视，将有助于加速新型能源基础设施的开发，并支持其持续实施。

各国政府可以主动引导基于可再生能源的能源系统建设，克服现有结构的缺陷和低效，从而更有效地影响最终成果。同步推动物理结构、政策框架和制度体系的变革，将是实现发展与气候目标、构建更具韧性和公平性的世界的关键。这些基础要素应当构成支撑能源转型的坚实支柱。

政策和监管的推动力量必须系统性地优先加速能源转型，减少化石燃料的比重。当前的政策和监管体系仍主要围绕化石燃料而构建。尽管在未来一段时间内化石燃料仍将是能源结构的一部分，但随着本世纪中叶的临近，其比例必须大幅下降。因此，政策框架与市场应集中力量加速这一转型，为构建一个具有韧性和包容性的能源系统提供坚实的基础支撑。

一支高技能劳动力队伍是推动能源转型成功的关键支柱。实现这一目标将需要多种职业类型的人才。要满足这些岗位的需求，教育和技能培训方面的协同行动势在必行，政府在其中起着至关重要的协调作用，以确保教育部门的课程设置与行业未来需求相一致——无论是职业培训还是高等教育课程。

articles.summary: 乡村旅游与文化内涵、生态保护
articles.text:
我国乡村旅游蓬勃发展，但也存在粗放式开发、创意不足等现象。发展乡村游，如何因地制宜？

首先，要让乡村人气兴旺。有些乡村景区建成后，把有意愿、有能力的村民重新请回来。村民或布置民俗景观，或在景区开商铺，还有的经营民宿。村民回来了，才有了原汁原味的乡土民俗，才有了农家小院里的乡音小调，才有了土灶上烹饪的本土小菜。只有留住原住村民，才能真实展示当地风俗本色。

此外，乡村游也需要文化内涵。有些村庄邀请本村和周边的手艺人、非遗传承人，将活态非遗融入传统村落风貌，为游客创造了体验传统文化的丰富载体，有效地增强了旅游吸引力同时，乡村旅游的可持续发展还需注重生态环境的保护。必须避免过度开发和破坏自然资源，确保绿水青山与经济效益并重。一些村庄推行生态农业、打造田园景观，结合农耕体验项目，在保留原生态环境的同时，提升了游客的参与感与互动性。

China's rural tourism is thriving, yet challenges such as unsustainable development and limited creativity remain. How can we develop rural tourism in a way that is responsive to the unique conditions of each area?

To truly revitalize rural communities, it is essential to bring back the people. In some rural tourist areas, once development is complete, willing and capable villagers are invited to return. These villagers may create traditional cultural displays, open shops, or operate homestays within the scenic area. With the return of the villagers, authentic rural customs and culture also come alive: local dialects echo through the courtyards, and native dishes are prepared on rustic stoves. Only by retaining the original residents can the true essence of local traditions be faithfully preserved and presented.

Moreover, rural tourism should be enriched with cultural depth. Some villages invite local artisans and inheritors of intangible cultural heritage from the village and surrounding areas, weaving these living traditions into the fabric of the village's landscape. This creates meaningful opportunities for visitors to engage with traditional culture, greatly enhancing the appeal and allure of rural tourism. For rural tourism to develop sustainably, ecological conservation must remain a priority. Overdevelopment and the depletion of natural resources should be carefully avoided to strike a balance between preserving green landscapes and generating economic benefits. Some villages have adopted ecological farming, created idyllic landscapes, and introduced hands-on farming experiences, which not only protect the natural environment but also deepen visitor engagement and interaction.
